alt: L.A. Care Health Plan profile on Local Health Plans of California
summary: A screenshot of the Local Health Plans of California (LHPC) member registry page for L.A. Care Health Plan on August 15, 2026. The association's official directory continues to direct public and legal entities to 1055 West Seventh Street, 10th Floor, Los Angeles, CA 90017, proving a complete lack of synchronization between LHPC's official registers and plan headquarters.
